voice.style: Friendly, calm teacher. Clear, unhurried, says exactly what to click.

lines.text: Here is the complete, step by step guide to Hoppy.
First, install it. Open Extensions, and search for Hoppy for Claude Code.
Click Install.
VS Code asks if you trust the publisher. Click Trust Publisher and Install.
Hoppy installs, opens a short guide, and appears in the status bar.
Click Claude in the status bar. The Hoppy menu opens at the top.
Each account shows the tokens it used in the last five hours, today, and this week.
Pick Personal. A new Claude tab opens on it right away, with no reload.
To add a Claude account, choose Add Claude account.
Give it a name, like Side project.
A new Claude tab opens. Log in there with that account. Each account keeps its own login.
Open Settings from the menu. Accounts shows every account and its usage.
Claude panel uses, at the top, switches where new tabs open.
Click Edit to rename an account, or to pick a status bar color.
Now a real example. You are deep in a task on Work. Open it again from Claude's history.
Ask for the next change, and Work hits its weekly limit.
Hoppy notices at once, and asks where to keep going.
Click Continue on Other AI.
The same chat opens on Other AI, with everything that came before.
Ask it to carry on, and it does. It adds the cart badge to App dot T S X.
Work shows when its limit resets, and Hoppy tells you when it is back.
Your chats travel with you. Switch to Personal, and open Claude's history.
The same chats are there. Pick one, and keep going on this account.
You can also move any chat yourself, with Continue a chat in the Hoppy menu.
To add other AI models, open Settings, then AI Providers.
Connected services are at the top. More are listed below.
Click Connect. Get a key, paste it, and click Test and save.
Hoppy checks every key before it saves it, and keys never leave this computer.
In Models, pick a main model for the real work, and a helper for small jobs.
Tick the models you want, then click Save models.
Backups take over when a model is busy, or out of free requests.
Click Check models, to see which ones work right now.
Today, OpenRouter's free requests are used up, and Hoppy shows exactly that, model by model. Put working first moves the ones that answer to the top.
To use other models directly, pick Other AI in the Hoppy menu.
Type slash model, to choose a model.
Control Alt H flips back to the account you used before.
Always use this account in this project pins a project to an account.
In More, you will find Export settings, and the second opinion skill.
Export settings saves your setup to a file.
It holds your models, backups, and account names. Never keys, and never logins.
On another computer, choose Import settings.
Your names, colors and choices arrive. Add your keys there, and you are ready.
Hoppy never touches your Claude login, and Claude is never billed twice.
Usage and limit checks read only local files.
That's Hoppy for Claude Code.
Free on the VS Code Marketplace.
